name: HiddenStats
author: VidereJP
description: Reveals each Pokemon's hidden stats on its Summary screen: IVs (converted from DVs, 0-31) and EVs (converted from Stat Exp, 0-255). Works standalone on the native Summary screen, adds a matching page to Gen1 Modern UI when installed, and (once its compatibility hook lands) integrates with Kanto Reforged.
